title: Spectate Portal: Make Create Clue submission reliable with immediate list update and clear feedback

requirements.summary: Ensure Create Clue submission consistently creates a clue, refreshes the Existing Clues list automatically, and shows clear success/error toasts with debug logging.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the Create Clue form creates a new clue and the new clue appears in the "Existing Clues" list without requiring a manual refresh.
On success, the form fields reset and a success toast is shown.
On failure (e.g., Unauthorized or validation errors), an error toast is shown with an English, human-readable message and the error is logged to the console for debugging.

file_operations.description: Harden the createClue mutation to reliably update UI state: after a successful create, proactively refetch clue summaries (and first-available clue) rather than only invalidating, so the new clue appears immediately without manual refresh; ensure errors are surfaced consistently for the UI to toast and continue logging to console.

Improve Create Clue form submission UX reliability: prevent accidental double-submits while pending, standardize success/failure toast messaging, and ensure failures produce a human-readable message while logging the full error object to the console for debugging. Keep all changes within this page and do not edit immutable ui component files.

Add a small shared utility to convert unknown thrown values (including agent/replica errors) into an English, human-readable message with special handling for authorization/validation-like cases; used by the Admin Create Clue flow to produce clear error toasts while preserving console debug logs.
